# Properties: ordered data and retained source

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
title: Note
tags: [a, b]
---
Body
.
Document scope=1:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..4:3 children=2
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:11 name="title" value=scalar(text("Note")) children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:12 name="tags" value=list([text("a"),text("b")]) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
tags:
  - project
aliases: ["Alt name"]
cssclasses: wide
link: "[[Episode IV]]"
---
.
Document scope=1:1..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
└── Metadata scope=1:1..7:3 children=4
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..3:11 name="tags" value=list([text("project")]) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:21 name="aliases" value=list([text("Alt name")]) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:16 name="cssclasses" value=scalar(text("wide")) children=0
    └── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..6:22 name="link" value=scalar(text("[[Episode IV]]")) children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
n: null
e:
b: true
i: 12
f: 1.50
d: 2024-01-01
s: "**Draft**"
---
.
Document scope=1:1..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
└── Metadata scope=1:1..9:3 children=7
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:7 name="n" value=scalar(null) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:2 name="e" value=scalar(null) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:7 name="b" value=scalar(bool(true)) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:5 name="i" value=scalar(number("12")) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..6:7 name="f" value=scalar(number("1.50")) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=7:1..7:13 name="d" value=scalar(text("2024-01-01")) children=0
    └── MetadataRecord scope=8:1..8:14 name="s" value=scalar(text("**Draft**")) children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
````````````````````````````````
```````````````````````````````` example
# just a comment
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..3:3 children=1
│   └── MetadataContent value=comment("# just a comment") children=0
└── Paragraph scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
a: 1

├── ThematicBreak scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
└── Heading scope=3:1..4:3 anchor=null attributes={} level=2 children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a: 1" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
"1": a
1.0: b
true: c
~: d
---
.
Document scope=1:1..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
└── Metadata scope=1:1..6:3 children=4
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:6 name="1" value=scalar(text("a")) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:6 name="1.0" value=scalar(text("b")) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:7 name="true" value=scalar(text("c")) children=0
    └── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:4 name="~" value=scalar(text("d")) children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
x: &a 1
y: *a
z: !!str 1
---
.
Document scope=1:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
└── Metadata scope=1:1..5:3 children=3
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:7 name="x" value=scalar(number("1")) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:5 name="y" value=scalar(number("1")) children=0
    └── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:10 name="z" value=scalar(text("1")) children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Module example

```````````````````````````````` example
---
title: Note
not YAML
...
key: [a, {b: c}]
count: 2
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..7:3 children=5
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:11 name="title" value=scalar(text("Note")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("not YAML") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("...") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("key: [a, {b: c}]") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..6:8 name="count" value=scalar(number("2")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=8:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=8:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## All branches and metadata opacity

```````````````````````````````` example
---
null-value: null
empty:
bool-value: false
number: 9007199254740993
negative-zero: -0
exponent: 1.0e+12
text: ""
list: [one, 2, "[[link]]", "%%comment%%"]
empty-list: []
syntax: "**bold** ==mark== $formula$ ^[note] <!--comment-->"
# source comment
...
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..15:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..14:3 children=12
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:16 name="null-value" value=scalar(null) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:6 name="empty" value=scalar(null) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:17 name="bool-value" value=scalar(bool(false)) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:24 name="number" value=scalar(number("9007199254740993")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..6:17 name="negative-zero" value=scalar(number("-0")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=7:1..7:17 name="exponent" value=scalar(number("1.0e+12")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=8:1..8:8 name="text" value=scalar(text("")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=9:1..9:41 name="list" value=list([text("one"),number("2"),text("[[link]]"),text("%%comment%%")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=10:1..10:14 name="empty-list" value=list([]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=11:1..11:60 name="syntax" value=scalar(text("**bold** ==mark== $formula$ ^[note] <!--comment-->")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("# source comment") children=0
│   └── MetadataContent value=comment("...") children=0
└── Paragraph scope=15:1..15:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=15:1..15:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Failed members preserve adjacent data

```````````````````````````````` example
---
before: first
not YAML
broken: [unclosed
after-broken: 2
nested: {key: value}
list-bool: [true]
list-null: [null]
list-nested: [[a]]
list-map: [{a: b}]
after: last
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..13:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..12:3 children=10
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:13 name="before" value=scalar(text("first")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("not YAML") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("broken: [unclosed") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:15 name="after-broken" value=scalar(number("2")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("nested: {key: value}") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("list-bool: [true]") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("list-null: [null]") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("list-nested: [[a]]") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("list-map: [{a: b}]") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=11:1..11:11 name="after" value=scalar(text("last")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=13:1..13:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=13:1..13:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Duplicate textual names and failed names

```````````````````````````````` example
---
"1": first
1: second
1.0: distinct
true: bool name
~: tilde name
"": empty name
"multi\nline": bad name
[complex, key]: value
? explicit
: value
!tag key: value
&a key: value
*alias: value
last: present
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..17:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..16:3 children=14
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:10 name="1" value=scalar(text("first")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("1: second") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:13 name="1.0" value=scalar(text("distinct")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:15 name="true" value=scalar(text("bool name")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..6:13 name="~" value=scalar(text("tilde name")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("\"\": empty name") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("\"multi\\nline\": bad name") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("[complex, key]: value") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("? explicit") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment(": value") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("!tag key: value") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("&a key: value") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("*alias: value") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=15:1..15:13 name="last" value=scalar(text("present")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=17:1..17:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=17:1..17:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Scalar resolution, quoted folds, escapes and tags

```````````````````````````````` example
---
tilde: ~
yes: yes
plus: +1
hex: 0x10
leading-zero: 01
infinity: .inf
date: 2026-09-08
quoted: "true"
folded: 'one
  two'
continued: "one\
  two"
unicode: "\x41\u4e2d\U0001f600\N\_\L\P"
null-tag: !!null null
empty-tag: !!null
bool-tag: !!bool false
int-tag: !!int -12
float-tag: !!float 1.50
str-tag: !!str true
uri-tag: !<tag:yaml.org,2002:str> 1
bad-bool: !!bool yes
bad-int: !!int 1.5
unknown: !custom one
last: present
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..27:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..26:3 children=22
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:8 name="tilde" value=scalar(text("~")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:8 name="yes" value=scalar(text("yes")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:8 name="plus" value=scalar(text("+1")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:9 name="hex" value=scalar(text("0x10")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..6:16 name="leading-zero" value=scalar(text("01")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=7:1..7:14 name="infinity" value=scalar(text(".inf")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=8:1..8:16 name="date" value=scalar(text("2026-09-08")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=9:1..9:14 name="quoted" value=scalar(text("true")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=10:1..11:6 name="folded" value=scalar(text("one two")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=12:1..13:6 name="continued" value=scalar(text("onetwo")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=14:1..14:39 name="unicode" value=scalar(text("A中😀   ")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=15:1..15:21 name="null-tag" value=scalar(null) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=16:1..16:17 name="empty-tag" value=scalar(null) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=17:1..17:22 name="bool-tag" value=scalar(bool(false)) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=18:1..18:18 name="int-tag" value=scalar(number("-12")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=19:1..19:23 name="float-tag" value=scalar(number("1.50")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=20:1..20:19 name="str-tag" value=scalar(text("true")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=21:1..21:35 name="uri-tag" value=scalar(text("1")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("bad-bool: !!bool yes") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("bad-int: !!int 1.5") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("unknown: !custom one") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=25:1..25:13 name="last" value=scalar(text("present")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=27:1..27:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=27:1..27:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Block scalar folding and chomping

```````````````````````````````` example
---
folded: >-
  one
  two
literal: |-
  one
with-newline: |
  one
blank-fold: >-
  one

  two
explicit: >2- # header comment
  first
  second
last: present
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..18:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..17:3 children=7
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..4:5 name="folded" value=scalar(text("one two")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..6:5 name="literal" value=scalar(text("one")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("with-newline: |\n  one") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("blank-fold: >-\n  one\n\n  two") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=13:1..15:8 name="explicit" value=scalar(text("first second")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("# header comment") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=16:1..16:13 name="last" value=scalar(text("present")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=18:1..18:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=18:1..18:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Lists, multiline flow, indentation and comments

```````````````````````````````` example
---
block:
  - one # item comment
  # between items
  - 2
indentless:
- three
- 4
flow: [
  one, # flow comment
  2
]
empty-tag: !!seq []
last: present
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..16:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..15:3 children=8
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..5:5 name="block" value=list([text("one"),number("2")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("# item comment") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("  # between items") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=6:1..8:3 name="indentless" value=list([text("three"),number("4")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=9:1..12:1 name="flow" value=list([text("one"),number("2")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("# flow comment") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=13:1..13:19 name="empty-tag" value=list([]) children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=14:1..14:13 name="last" value=scalar(text("present")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=16:1..16:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=16:1..16:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Aliases, shadow rollback and cycle detection

```````````````````````````````` example
---
base: &a 9007199254740993
copy: *a
list: &l [*a, &b text, *b]
list-copy: *l
bad: &a [true]
after-bad: *a
cycle: &a [*a]
after-cycle: *a
undefined: *missing
next: &a replacement
last: *a
---
body
.
Document scope=1:1..14:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..13:3 children=11
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:25 name="base" value=scalar(number("9007199254740993")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:8 name="copy" value=scalar(number("9007199254740993")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:1..4:26 name="list" value=list([number("9007199254740993"),text("text"),text("text")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..5:13 name="list-copy" value=list([number("9007199254740993"),text("text"),text("text")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("bad: &a [true]") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=7:1..7:13 name="after-bad" value=scalar(number("9007199254740993")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("cycle: &a [*a]") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=9:1..9:15 name="after-cycle" value=scalar(number("9007199254740993")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("undefined: *missing") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=11:1..11:20 name="next" value=scalar(text("replacement")) children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=12:1..12:8 name="last" value=scalar(text("replacement")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=14:1..14:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=14:1..14:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## JSON root members share scalar and list projection

```````````````````````````````` example
---
{"a":1,"nested":{"b":2},"after": [3,"x"],"a":4,"last":false}

body
.

├── Metadata scope=1:1..3:3 children=5
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:2..2:6 name="a" value=scalar(number("1")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("\"nested\":{\"b\":2}") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:25..2:40 name="after" value=list([number("3"),text("x")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("\"a\":4") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=2:48..2:59 name="last" value=scalar(bool(false)) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Flow mappings retain comments and quote punctuation

```````````````````````````````` example
---
{
  name: don't,
  quoted: "a,b:c", # inline
  list: [x, y],
  unsupported: [false],
  last: null
}
---

.

├── Metadata scope=1:1..9:3 children=6
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:3..3:13 name="name" value=scalar(text("don't")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=4:3..4:17 name="quoted" value=scalar(text("a,b:c")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("# inline") children=0
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:3..5:14 name="list" value=list([text("x"),text("y")]) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("unsupported: [false]") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=7:3..7:12 name="last" value=scalar(null) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=10:1..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=10:1..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Indicators are comments and never delimiters

```````````````````````````````` example
---

.

│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:9 name="before" value=scalar(number("1")) children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("...") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("... # doc end") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("%YAML 1.2") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("%TAG !e! tag:example.com,2000:app/") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("--- extra") children=0
│   ├── MetadataContent value=comment("----") children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=9:1..9:8 name="after" value=scalar(number("2")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=11:1..11:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=11:1..11:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Block scalar owns quote and bracket source

```````````````````````````````` example
---
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
 	two"

	two"}
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
  ], # after
  # end
````````````````````````````````

## Flow punctuation stays structural and prefixes retain collection ownership

```````````````````````````````` example

- separate source sequence

# value comment

  one,
  two
]
bad: [
x[y: 5
last: 6
---
.

└── Metadata scope=1:1..14:3 children=11
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:2..2:8 name="good" value=scalar(text("x")) children=0
    ├── MetadataContent value=comment("b[c]: 2") children=0
    ├── MetadataContent value=comment("nested: {value: 3}") children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:40..2:47 name="after" value=scalar(number("4")) children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:13 name="plain" value=scalar(text("text [")) children=0
    ├── MetadataContent value=comment("- separate source sequence") children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=5:1..10:1 name="pending" value=list([text("one"),text("two")]) children=0
    ├── MetadataContent value=comment("# value comment") children=0
    ├── MetadataContent value=comment("bad: [") children=0
    ├── MetadataRecord scope=12:1..12:6 name="x[y" value=scalar(number("5")) children=0
    └── MetadataRecord scope=13:1..13:7 name="last" value=scalar(number("6")) children=0
````````````````````````````````
